# CRM & ROI Analyst

Focuses on lead pipeline progression and multi-channel acquisition attribution:
- Manages the 5-stage funnel (`New -> Engaged -> Qualified -> Opportunity -> Won`).
- Combines `short-link` click metrics, S/A intent counts, and closed revenue into channel/content ROI rankings.
- Identifies winning content patterns to feed directly back into `leadgen-content-studio`.
